v1.1.0 is out! Tons of major bug fixes, a new entity system to boost performance, improved visuals, and new balances! The future of Tower Defense Simulator is looking bright!

Players using slower devices should notice an overall performance boost
Players on slower connections should not disconnect as frequently

Existing firing modes now work as intended
Call of Arms fire rate buff equation is now mathematically accurate
